newsitem.title: USA: Fed says adds reserves via $1.0 bln customer RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed says adds reserves via $1.0 bln customer RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added temporary reserves to the open market on Tuesday through $1.0 billion in customer repurchase agreements, a Fed spokeswoman confirmed.

Analysts had expected the Fed to refrain from open market operations, asserting also that between now and after the Thanksgiving Day holiday, the Fed will need to add permanent reserves to the banking system by buying coupons outright.
Fed funds traded at 5-1/8 percent at the time of the operation, below the Fed's 5-1/4 percent target for the rate.
